name: SM_Bed_Oak_PR
supersedes: Stonebrook/SM_Bed_Oak_01 (2.51 x 1.37 x 1.12 m, base_center) and the family binding of bed (16 placements)
dresses: oak bed 2.5 x 1.36 x 1.15 m (head at -X): four capped posts, plank head and foot boards, pegged side rails, slats, a lumpy sagging straw tick in striped linen, a pressure-simulated pillow, a quilted wool blanket (olive-yellow, madder lining and border) simulated over the tick, hanging over the rails and turned back at the head end
build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2 unique bake with cloth simulation (blanket and pillow; cached in _build/bake/cache), five review rounds (r6). Last look still faults: the blanket lies too flat on top (the 7 percent slack gave only shallow ripples, real folds show only at the turn-back and the hanging sides), its olive-yellow is even and the quilting is a regular diamond bump; the pillow is plump but smooth, without a sewn seam bead; tick stripes are printed-looking; the underside chart of the blanket bakes partly wrong where it lies on the tick (hidden in game). One 2048 set for a 2.5 m prop: soft at 1 m.
